items.text: Seahawks activated RB Zach Charbonnet from PUP; he was full participant Wednesday and has a chance to debut vs Chiefs after ACL recovery. Corresponding move placed TE Elijah Arroyo on IR.
items.why: 21-day window closing; full practice; Macdonald indicated possible Week 7 snaps.
items.implication: Potential committee or lead-back emergence ROS; monitor snap share vs Walker.
items.opportunity: Immediate backfield dilution or expansion for SEA RBs; Charbonnet prior co-starter volume.

items.text: Saquon Barkley expected to practice Thursday and 'in line' to play Monday vs Cowboys after hamstring; efficient in prior full games. Dallas strong RB matchup.
items.why: Hamstring recovery; practice return; Garafolo/NFL Network reports align with Berry note.
items.implication: RB1 upside restored for MNF; Eagles backfield thin otherwise.
items.opportunity: High-volume carries/red-zone in favorable matchup; reverse any backup beneficiaries.

items.text: Seahawks TE Elijah Arroyo undergoing shoulder surgery today and will miss the rest of the season; placed on IR.
items.implication: TE depth hit for SEA; targets redistribute to WRs/RBs.

items.text: Josh Jacobs allowed in Packers facility for meetings, lifting, medical/non-football activities. MarShawn Lloyd (49th EPA/rush) and Kaleb Johnson (53rd) have been bad; OL mess. Long-term outlook discussed on ROS Top-150.
items.why: Facility access signals progress post-arrest/exempt; backups inefficient.
items.implication: Jacobs workload return imminent; fade current committee.
items.opportunity: Reclaim lead role; reverse Lloyd/Johnson beneficiaries.
items.conflict: Berry hates Jacobs Week 7 on layoff workload questions.

items.text: Lamar Jackson present for start of Thursday practice after no sign Wednesday; HC said he got limited work Wednesday. Ankle injury monitoring.
items.why: Progress from Wednesday absence; limited participation noted.
items.implication: Trending toward availability but rushing may be limited if plays.

items.text: Terrance Ferguson (IR-eligible) not expected ready soon per Schefter source; recovery 'will take some time.' With Adams out, Rams' answer is 25 Puka Nacua targets per game.
items.why: Ferguson delay removes primary beneficiary; Adams multi-week absence.
items.implication: Elite WR1 target monster ROS; massive volume spike.
items.opportunity: 25 targets/game projected; routes/red-zone expansion without Adams/Ferguson.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @ CHI (WR10): Bears good for yardage; Brown back in real role with usage/matchup juice.
items.why: Matchup vs Bears defense + role return.

items.text: Loves DeVonta Smith vs DAL (WR11): elite volume; Lions-like gift defenses theme extends to pass-catchers.
Loves Tucker Kraft @ DET (TE6), Jaylen Warren @ NO (RB9), Chuba Hubbard vs TB (RB10), Bucky Irving @ CAR (RB12): big workloads + friendly matchups (Lions gift to pass-catchers; RB-friendly defenses).
Hates Josh Jacobs @ DET (RB18) on workload questions after long layoff; Cam Skattebo @ HOU (RB37) in brutal spot; also fades Emanuel Wilson role squeeze.
items.why: Layoff uncertainty for Jacobs; tough matchup/role for Skattebo.
items.conflict: Levitan notes Jacobs facility progress and bad backups EPA, potential upgrade signal.

items.text: Hates Rome Odunze vs NE (WR32), Josh Downs @ MIN (WR41), Travis Kelce @ SEA (TE9): nasty matchups and/or suboptimal roles/target shares on low-scoring offenses.
Buccaneers QB Baker Mayfield listed as full participant in Wednesday practice.
items.implication: Clears path for start; positive for TB skill players.

items.text: Yards per target to Justin Jefferson: Mullens 10.8, Cousins 10.5, Darnold 10.0, Wentz 9.9, JJ McCarthy 5.7. Tough to ignore despite scheme/coach/sample caveats; Giants plan start McCarthy vs Houston noted in quote.
items.why: Low YPT efficiency with McCarthy in limited sample.
items.implication: Potential ceiling concern if QB situation persists.

items.text: Bears Week 10 bye then soft ROS close: Saints (27th YPP), Lions (24th), Jags (26th), Dolphins (21st), Bills (25th), Packers (3rd), Lions. Season so far mixed (weather/Keenum/Bagent).
items.implication: Boost for Bears skill players ROS rankings/value.
